title: When the Aftermath Turns
author: Xanthe Thackeray
blurb: Cyrus Marchetti, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
